items.title: dominikmartn/harp
items.why: It helps you manage multiple AI coding assistants like Claude Code in one single interface.
items.summary: Harp is a desktop sidebar application that runs multiple AI coding agents concurrently and alerts you when one needs human input.

items.title: A practical guide to AI image generation, from diffusion to agents
items.why: It breaks down how modern AI image generation works step-by-step in an approachable way.
items.summary: A practical walkthrough explaining diffusion models and AI image generation techniques without requiring heavy math background.

items.title: Show HN: Corgi, a helpful {agent, terminal} multiplexer
items.why: It is an open-source tool designed to manage multiple coding AI agents from your terminal.
items.summary: Corgi is a terminal multiplexer that lets developers run and organize multiple AI agents side by side in one command line interface.

items.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed
items.why: It introduces a fast new LLM series specifically designed for coding tasks.
items.summary: Kimi released its K3.1 Pro AI models, optimized for software development with low latency and high-speed response modes.

items.title: wesbos/3d-model-anything
items.why: It demonstrates how to combine mobile camera sensors with web graphics libraries to make 3D models.
items.summary: An open-source library by Wes Bos that converts iPhone LiDAR scans into interactive 3D web environments using Three.js.

items.title: colinhacks/reylo
items.why: It simplifies working with databases in Web development by linking SQL and TypeScript directly.
items.summary: Reylo is a TypeScript utility that imports raw SQL files with full type safety and zero code generation steps.

items.title: ELY-Open-Source/ElyOffice
items.why: It is an open-source example of building modern offline desktop applications using Rust.
items.summary: ElyOffice provides offline-first desktop productivity apps built with Rust and GPU-accelerated UI components.

items.title: WorldTUI: I trained a 360M model to pretend to be a terminal
items.why: It shows a creative AI project where a small open-source language model simulates a command-line terminal.
items.summary: WorldTUI is a lightweight 360 million parameter AI model trained to mimic terminal commands and responses.

items.title: xevrion/hatchzip
items.why: It is a clever open-source tool that solves file storage limits when extracting large zip archives.
items.summary: Hatchzip unzips large archives in place by deleting compressed files as they extract, saving local disk space.

items.title: No signs of AI payoff outside the tech sector
items.why: It offers realistic perspective on how AI adoption is impacting traditional industries beyond tech.
items.summary: A discussion analyzing economic data on whether generative AI tools are driving measurable productivity gains in non-tech businesses.

items.title: Why is AI generated language so hard to understand?
items.why: It discusses why AI-generated writing often feels unnatural or difficult to read.
items.summary: An exploration into the linguistic patterns and stylistic quirks that make AI text feel verbose and hard to digest.

items.title: Local Wikipedia: Wikipedia, but only for things a half hour walk from you
items.why: It is a fun web project idea that filters Wikipedia articles based on your immediate physical location.
items.summary: Local Wikipedia displays Wikipedia entries exclusively for points of interest within a short walking distance of the user.

items.title: Ukraine says Starlink connection 'now stable' after network limits
items.why: It covers critical news on satellite internet infrastructure supporting emergency operations.
items.summary: Starlink satellite internet service in Ukraine has returned to normal operating speeds following a week of severe connection limits.

items.title: Trump lauds Melania over Russia-Ukraine localised ceasefire deal
items.why: It provides key world news regarding diplomatic developments in the Russia-Ukraine conflict.
items.summary: A localized diplomatic ceasefire agreement was reached in the Ukrainian region of Oleshky.
